zh:
> 本文依据 [LosslessCut 固定版本 README](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/blob/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/README.md) 翻译；项目采用 [GPL-2.0](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/blob/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/LICENSE)，图标另有署名许可，详见文末。

LosslessCut

无损视频与音频编辑的瑞士军刀


感谢[支持者](https://mifi.no/thanks/)和所有购买 LosslessCut 的人！



LosslessCut 致力于成为跨平台的 FFmpeg 图形界面，让视频、音频、字幕和其他相关媒体文件的操作极快且无损。主要功能是无损裁剪音视频文件，非常适合粗剪摄像机、GoPro 或无人机等拍摄的大型视频以节省空间。它可让你快速提取视频中的精彩部分并丢弃数 GB 数据，无须缓慢地重新编码并因此损失画质。它还有许多其他[用途](https://losslesscut.app/docs/features#example-use-cases)。由于几乎直接复制数据，所有操作都很快；繁重工作由出色的 FFmpeg 完成。 ## 目录 - [功能](#features) - [下载](#download) - [支持的格式](#supported-formats) - [文档、使用与入门](#documentation) - [视频演示](#video-demos) - [相关报道](#featured) - [署名](#attributions) ## 功能 - 在几秒内无损裁剪视频和音频 - 无损合并剪切片段或编解码器相同的完整文件 - 添加、删除、替换或提取音轨、字幕等轨道 - 无须重新编码即可更换格式（重新封装），例如从 MKV 转为 MP4 - 片段、标记和标签；支持导入或导出章节、CSV、EDL 等 - 检测场景、黑帧及静音，并据此拆分 - 编辑元数据和旋转角度，创建章节 - 打开几乎任何格式，包括播放器无法播放的格式 - 截图和帧导出、键盘快捷键、[命令行界面](https://losslesscut.app/docs/cli)以及 [HTTP API](https://losslesscut.app/docs/api) **[所有功能和使用示例 →](https://losslesscut.app/docs/features)** 另见[操作方法集](https://losslesscut.app/docs/recipes)。 ## 下载 如果你想支持我持续开发 LosslessCut，同时希望通过安全、简单的安装流程获得自动且稳定的更新，可以考虑从你喜欢的商店获取： Linux 版本发布在 Snap Store： 如果更喜欢手动下载可执行文件，这当然始终免费（另见[支持的操作系统](https://losslesscut.app/docs/requirements)）： - macOS：[Intel](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-mac-x64.dmg) / [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-mac-arm64.dmg) DMG（注意 PKG **不可用**） - Windows：[7zip](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-win-x64.7z)（Windows 7、8 和 8.1 在 [v3.50.0 后不再受支持](https://losslesscut.app/docs/requirements)） - Linux：[x64 tar.bz2](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-x64.tar.bz2) / [x64 AppImage](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-x86_64.AppImage) / [arm64 tar.bz2](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-arm64.tar.bz2) - [更多发行版](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases)——注意 APPX（Windows）和 PKG（macOS）**不可用** - [最新 nightly 构建 🧪](https://mifi.no/llc/nightly/) 请注意以上是[唯一的官方下载渠道](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq#can-i-download-losslesscut-from-other-websites-or-package-managers)。也有非官方发行版，例如 [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/details/no.mifi.losslesscut)（并非由我维护）。应用商店版本和 GitHub 下载版有何区别？[请参阅 FAQ](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq#is-losslesscut-free-whats-the-difference-between-the-app-store-and-github-versions)。 [![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mifi/lossless-cut/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/donate.svg)](https://mifi.no/thanks) LosslessCut 由我一人维护，并将始终免费开源。如果它对你有用，请考虑支持我的工作。或者[捐赠 FFmpeg 团队](https://www.ffmpeg.org/donations.html)，因为他们为世界做出了巨大贡献。 [Paypal](https://paypal.me/mifino/usd) | [加密货币](https://mifi.no/thanks) | [更多](https://mifi.no/thanks) ## 支持的格式 LosslessCut 使用 Chromium 浏览器的 HTML5 视频播放器，并非所有格式和编解码器都[受到原生支持](https://www.chromium.org/audio-video)。通常可用的文件格式包括 `MP4`、`MOV`、`WebM`、`Matroska`、`OGG` 和 `WAV`；音频编解码器包括 `FLAC`、`MP3`、`Opus`、`PCM`、`Vorbis` 和 `AAC`；视频编解码器包括 `H264`、`AV1`、`Theora`、`VP8`、`VP9` 和 `H265`（需要硬件解码器）。了解[编解码器和格式的区别](https://losslesscut.app/docs#primer-videoaudio-codecs-vs-formats)。其他编解码器和格式的文件改由 FFmpeg 播放（*FFmpeg 辅助播放*）：LosslessCut 知道不支持时自动启用，也可从 `File` → *Convert to supported format* 启用。导出仍然使用原文件，因此仍是无损的。这意味着你可以打开 FFmpeg 能解码的几乎任何文件。 ## 文档 - 官方网站：[LosslessCut.app](https://losslesscut.app) - **[入门](https://losslesscut.app/docs/getting-started)** - [常见问题](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq) - [使用文档](https://losslesscut.app/docs) - [故障排查、已知问题与限制](https://losslesscut.app/docs/troubleshooting) - [参与贡献](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/blob/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### 视频演示 - [常用功能](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYHMxXy05Jg) - [如何为 MP4 添加缩略图或封面](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4pYJ93cn80E) - [如何为视频添加多语言音轨](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MRBGDsuw_WU) - 你的视频也可以放在这里？ ## 相关报道 - [Console newsletter](https://console.substack.com/p/console-93) - Hacker News：[2024](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40829494) [2022](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=33969490) [2020-10](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=24883030) [2020-01](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=22026412) [2016](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=12885585) - [维基百科](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/LosslessCut) - 你的链接也可以放在这里？ - theo（YouTube）：[1](https://youtu.be/FI5ba4RRE8U?t=246) [2](https://youtu.be/uaCypXEJjes?t=381) ## 署名 - 应用图标由 [Dimi Kazak](http://www.flaticon.com/authors/dimi-kazak "Dimi Kazak") 制作，来自 [www.flaticon.com](http://www.flaticon.com "Flaticon")，采用 [CC BY 3.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ "Creative Commons BY 3.0") 许可。 - [Chris Gannon 制作的 Lottie 动画](https://lottiefiles.com/7077-magic-flow)。 - 感谢 Adi Abinun 和 [@abdul-alhasany](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/issues/2561) 参与界面工作。 - 感谢帮助翻译应用的译者。[你也可以参与！](https://losslesscut.app/docs/translation) - [感谢所有支持](https://mifi.no/thanks/)我开源工作的人 🙌 --- 在 [🇳🇴](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uQIv8Vo9_Jc) 用 ❤️ 制作。 [mifi.no 的更多应用](https://mifi.no/) 在 [GitHub](https://github.com/mifi/)、[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6XlvVH63g0H54HSJubURQA)、[IG](https://www.instagram.com/mifi.no/)、[Twitter](https://twitter.com/mifi_no) 关注我，获取更多精彩内容！
en:
LosslessCut

The swiss army knife of lossless video/audio editing


Thanks to my supporters and everyone who purchased LosslessCut!



LosslessCut aims to be the ultimate cross platform FFmpeg GUI for extremely fast and lossless operations on video, audio, subtitle and other related media files. The main feature is lossless trimming and cutting of video and audio files, which is great for saving space by rough-cutting your large video files taken from a video camera, GoPro, drone, etc. It lets you quickly extract the good parts from your videos and discard many gigabytes of data without doing a slow re-encode and thereby losing quality. There are also many more [use cases](https://losslesscut.app/docs/features#example-use-cases). Everything is extremely fast because it does an almost direct data copy, fueled by the awesome FFmpeg which does all the grunt work. ## Table of contents - [Features](#features) - [Download](#download) - [Supported formats](#supported-formats) - [Documentation, usage & getting started](#documentation) - [Video demos](#video-demos) - [Featured](#featured) - [Attributions](#attributions) ## Features - Cut and trim video and audio losslessly, in seconds - Merge cut segments, or whole files with identical codecs, losslessly - Add, remove, replace or extract tracks: audio, subtitles and more - Change the format (remux), for example from MKV to MP4, without re-encoding - Segments, markers and tags, with import/export of chapters, CSV, EDL and more - Detect scenes, black frames and silence, and split by them - Edit metadata and rotation, and create chapters - Opens almost any format, even ones your player can't play - Snapshots and frame export, keyboard shortcuts, a [CLI](https://losslesscut.app/docs/cli) and an [HTTP API](https://losslesscut.app/docs/api) **[All features and example use cases →](https://losslesscut.app/docs/features)** See also the [Recipe cookbook](https://losslesscut.app/docs/recipes). ## Download If you want to support my continued work on LosslessCut, and you want the advantage of a secure and simple installation process with automatic, stable updates, consider getting it from your favorite store: For Linux I publish to the Snap Store: If you prefer to download the executables manually, this will of course always be free (see also [supported operating systems](https://losslesscut.app/docs/requirements)): - macOS: [Intel](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-mac-x64.dmg) / [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-mac-arm64.dmg) DMG (note that PKG does **not** work) - Windows: [7zip](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-win-x64.7z) (Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 is [no longer supported after v3.50.0](https://losslesscut.app/docs/requirements)) - Linux: [x64 tar.bz2](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-x64.tar.bz2) / [x64 AppImage](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-x86_64.AppImage) / [arm64 tar.bz2](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases/latest/download/LosslessCut-linux-arm64.tar.bz2) - [More releases](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/releases) - Note that APPX (Windows) and PKG (macOS) do **not** work - [Latest nightly builds 🧪](https://mifi.no/llc/nightly/) Note that the above are the [only official downloads](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq#can-i-download-losslesscut-from-other-websites-or-package-managers). There are also unofficial releases like [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/details/no.mifi.losslesscut) (not maintained by me). Difference between App Stores and GitHub download? [Please see FAQ](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq#is-losslesscut-free-whats-the-difference-between-the-app-store-and-github-versions). [![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mifi/lossless-cut/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/donate.svg)](https://mifi.no/thanks) LosslessCut is maintained by me alone and will always remain free and open source. If it's useful to you, consider supporting my work. Alternatively [donate to the FFmpeg team](https://www.ffmpeg.org/donations.html) because they are doing the world a huge favor. [Paypal](https://paypal.me/mifino/usd) | [crypto](https://mifi.no/thanks) | [more](https://mifi.no/thanks) ## Supported formats LosslessCut uses the Chromium browser's HTML5 video player, and not all formats/codecs are [natively supported](https://www.chromium.org/audio-video). Generally, the following file formats work: `MP4`, `MOV`, `WebM`, `Matroska`, `OGG` and `WAV`. Audio codecs: `FLAC`, `MP3`, `Opus`, `PCM`, `Vorbis` and `AAC`. Video codecs: `H264`, `AV1`, `Theora`, `VP8`, `VP9` and `H265` (with hardware decoder). Learn the [difference between a codec and a format](https://losslesscut.app/docs#primer-videoaudio-codecs-vs-formats). Files with other codecs and formats are played through FFmpeg instead (*FFmpeg-assisted playback*), automatically when LosslessCut knows they're unsupported, or from `File` → *Convert to supported format*. The export is still done from the original file, so it's still lossless. This means you can open almost any file that FFmpeg can decode. ## Documentation - Official website: [LosslessCut.app](https://losslesscut.app) - **[Getting started](https://losslesscut.app/docs/getting-started)** - [FAQ](https://losslesscut.app/docs/faq) - [Usage documentation](https://losslesscut.app/docs) - [Troubleshooting and known issues and limitations](https://losslesscut.app/docs/troubleshooting) - [Contributing](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/blob/6fc47dd4cc81b72a8f1b3132c47a99880cd9bbdb/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Video demos - [Common features](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYHMxXy05Jg) - [How to add a thumbnail / cover art to an MP4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4pYJ93cn80E) - [How to add multi-language audio to a video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MRBGDsuw_WU) - Your video here? ## Featured - [Console newsletter](https://console.substack.com/p/console-93) - Hacker News [2024](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40829494) [2022](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=33969490) [2020-10](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=24883030) [2020-01](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=22026412) [2016](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=12885585) - [Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/LosslessCut) - Your link here? - theo (YouTube) [1](https://youtu.be/FI5ba4RRE8U?t=246) [2](https://youtu.be/uaCypXEJjes?t=381) ## Attributions - App icon made by [Dimi Kazak](http://www.flaticon.com/authors/dimi-kazak "Dimi Kazak") from [www.flaticon.com](http://www.flaticon.com "Flaticon") is licensed by [CC 3.0 BY](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ "Creative Commons BY 3.0"). - [Lottie animation by Chris Gannon](https://lottiefiles.com/7077-magic-flow). - Thanks to Adi Abinun and [@abdul-alhasany](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut/issues/2561) for UI work. - Thanks to translators who helped translate the app. [You can too!](https://losslesscut.app/docs/translation) - [Thanks to everyone for supporting](https://mifi.no/thanks/) my open source work 🙌 --- Made with ❤️ in [🇳🇴](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uQIv8Vo9_Jc) [More apps by mifi.no](https://mifi.no/) Follow me on [GitHub](https://github.com/mifi/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6XlvVH63g0H54HSJubURQA), [IG](https://www.instagram.com/mifi.no/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/mifi_no) for more awesome content!
